start: Talking to Ali Morrisane, north of Faruq in Al Kharid
requirements:
* The Feud
* Icthlarin's Little Helper (partial; allows access into Sophanem) for clothing
items:
* Coins - to pay the Street Urchin to conspire against the Blackjack seller (required for defensive blackjacks) and for Magic carpet rides (optional)
* 3 dyes of any colour (for desert outfits) or
* 3 animal pelts of the same kind - cowhide, wool, snakeskin, any type of fur, etc. (for Menaphite clothing, can be obtained in Pollnivneach) See Part 3 below for hides that do not work.
recommended:
* Ring of charos (a) to reduce the cost of Magic carpet rides
* Enchanted broomstick
* Items to negate the effects of desert heat (e.g. desert clothing, enchanted water tiara, waterskins)
** Alternatively, the Crocodile Tears quest grants immunity against desert heat.
* Master camouflage outfit has teleports to Pollnivneach (more option, then Pollnivneach) and Sophanem (Pyramid Plunder option). No items to negate desert heat are needed with it, as you won't need to travel through the desert.
